messages:
Omar (cust-sec): quick follow-up from the SOC call — they want an evidence bundle showing immutable audit logs shipped to customer SIEM, proof we're using an HSM/FIPS path for tenant keys, and a clear RBAC change process for emergency access. can we enumerate what we can provide?
Maya (sec-eng): yep. we can provide signed log export (s3 + sig), SIEM delivery details (syslog over TLS or kafka sink), and HSM attestation for private infra deploys. for hosted customers we have envelope keys in KMS, not HSM; can you confirm which deployment they're asking about?
Omar (cust-sec): it's for the enterprise pilot — they want private deployment in their VPC with optional HSM. ask: can we show key provenance + rotation logs? also they want a runbook for "break-glass" RBAC changes + audit trail.
Liam (infra): for private-vpc + onprem HSM we can provide attest certs and a KMS audit stream. rotation events are emitted to our audit log service as: 
```
event: kms.rotate_key
actor: service-account:rotation-bot
key_id: tenant/ORION/2026-02
status: success
```
we keep key rotation history for 1 year by default, longer retention can be configured for enterprise contracts.
Priya (compliance): we'll need a minimal artifact list to send to the customer before next week's call: 1) signed log export sample (last 7 days), 2) HSM attestation doc OR KMS key policy snapshot, 3) RBAC change playbook (who signs, SLA, audit queries). i'll draft the packet.
Maya (sec-eng): RBAC flow: PR in infra repo -> runbook checks -> approvers (sec+infra+acct owner) -> time-limited guest role created -> actions recorded to audit log + immutable export. we can show a redacted sample audit query and an example query response. also note: emergency access is through an "emergency_bypass" workflow with two-person approval and a 72h auto-expire.
Omar (cust-sec): perfect. one question: SIEM ingest — they asked about proof logs are tamper-evident on arrival. can we support signed delivery and provide a verification script?
Maya (sec-eng): yes, we sign batches with a rotating signing key and publish the verification public key. example verification (toy):
```
# fetch bundle
curl -s -o bundle.tar.gz https://logs.redwood.example/tenant/orion/latest
# verify signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
we'll include the automation script in the evidence packet.
SecBot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-1987 — "ORION pilot evidence & RBAC runbook". Assigned to maya, priya, liam. ETA initial packet: 48h. :white_check_mark:
Priya (compliance): scheduling a 30m follow-up on Tue 10am PT. @Omar can you confirm attendees? i'll attach the artifacts before the meeting.
Omar (cust-sec): confirmed, they'll include infra + SOC lead. thanks — leaning on you all for the 48h deliverable.
Liam (infra): will push a redacted rotation log export to the ticket bucket and add the SIEM TLS config snippet: `tcp://splunk-cust:6514?ssl=true`.
Maya (sec-eng): i'll assemble the RBAC runbook (markdown) and a sample audit query (ELK/KQL + export). putting PR up in 2 business days, uploading draft to the ticket now.
Omar (cust-sec): great. feel free to ping me in thread if you need specific customer identifiers for redaction.
Priya (compliance): noted. will coordinate redaction checklist. thanks all :rocket:
